# @true-tech-team/ui-components

> React + TypeScript component library (SCSS modules, CSS custom-property theming, light/dark).
> Import components from '@true-tech-team/ui-components', import
> '@true-tech-team/ui-components/index.css' once at the app root, and wrap the app in
> <GlobalProvider>. The app-builder layer (Page, Section, URL params, mutations, router adapters) is a separate entry, '@true-tech-team/ui-components/app', and needs @tanstack/react-query. All components are client-only. Design guidelines for coding agents ship in
> ./guidelines/ inside this package.

## Start here

- [Guidelines index](guidelines/README.md): how to apply the rules, rule vocabulary, precedence
- [Design decision tree](guidelines/decision-tree.md): routes any UI task to the right rule
- [Choosing components](guidelines/components/choosing.md): actions, inputs, feedback, overlays, navigation, labels, loading
- [Component catalog](guidelines/components/catalog.md): every export with use-when / avoid-when, including the app builder (`/app`)

## Foundations

- [Tokens](guidelines/foundations/tokens.md): all CSS custom properties
- [Color](guidelines/foundations/color.md): roles, contrast, semantic colors, dark mode, picking colors
- [Typography](guidelines/foundations/typography.md): scale, hierarchy, line length, numbers, UI writing
- [Spacing & layout](guidelines/foundations/spacing-layout.md): 4px grid, proximity, density, breakpoints, layout components
- [Elevation & shape](guidelines/foundations/elevation-shape.md): surfaces, shadows, radius, z-index
- [Motion](guidelines/foundations/motion.md): durations, easing, reduced motion
- [Accessibility](guidelines/foundations/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 AA requirements
- [Labels](guidelines/foundations/labels.md): translatable built-in text, `ui.` prefix, key table

## Patterns

- [Forms](guidelines/patterns/forms.md)
- [Data display](guidelines/patterns/data-display.md): tables, lists, cards, filters, KPIs
- [Feedback & states](guidelines/patterns/feedback-states.md): loading, empty, error, success, toasts
- [Page layout](guidelines/patterns/page-layout.md): app shell, page types, dashboards, responsive

## Building pages from data (`/app` templates)

- [Workflow](guidelines/app/README.md): outline + sample API response → page brief → template → code
- [Page brief](guidelines/app/page-brief.md): the brief to fill before building, with an empty template
- [Choosing a page](guidelines/app/choosing-a-page.md): DataTablePage, DetailsPage, DashboardPage, form, settings, AppShell (APP-*)
- [Field display](guidelines/app/field-display.md): JSON/schema types → FieldValue kinds, placement, column budget (FIELD-*)
- [Hierarchy](guidelines/app/hierarchy.md): top-left priority, one primary action, progressive disclosure, tabs (HIER-*)
- [States](guidelines/app/states.md): structure-first loading, nothing yet vs no results, errors, forbidden, not found (APP-STATE-*)
- [Plumbing](guidelines/app/plumbing.md): URL vs local vs page state, polling, keepPreviousData, permissions, feedback, Next.js (APP-PLUMB-*)
- [Worked example](guidelines/app/example.md): marketing campaigns list + details page
